name.description: Visible product name; at most 150 characters. Null if unknown.

category.description: Recognizable product category; at most 100 characters. Null if unknown.

description.description: Concise factual description based on visible evidence, or null.

keyFeatures.description: Visible features in one plain-text string, or null. Never an array.

targetAudience.description: Audience only if explicitly supported by visible evidence; at most 255 characters. Otherwise null.

imageUrl.description: Return null. A hosted image URL cannot be obtained from the uploaded image.
